_comment: Kitsune's own fixes and additions, applied last over the merged sources by cmd/update-fingerprints (schema in cmd/update-fingerprints/overrides.go). remove runs first, then set, then add. Patterns are Wappalyzer-format and must be valid RE2; the engine matches them case-insensitively.

Apple iCloud Mail._comment: apple-domain= TXT records verify any Apple service (Apple Business, Sign in with Apple), not iCloud Mail.

WebsiteBuilder._comment: Matched any generator ending in 'Website Builder' (Wix, GoDaddy, Hostinger, ...).

Ruby on Rails._comment: _session_id is the default session cookie of many frameworks (PHP apps, Express, Java).

Joomla._comment: Generic ids and classes that other sites use; the html pattern still covers Joomla's own markup.

Cart Functionality._comment: Substring matches: /order matched /orders-history, /ordering; /cart matched /cartography; class*='checkout' matched any checkout text. Replaced in add with anchored rules.

Fourthwall._comment: Took the version of any page with <meta name=version>.

Google Tag Manager._comment: Any script from googletagmanager.com, including gtag.js for Google Analytics, which isn't GTM.

Cloudflare._comment: NS/SOA on cloudflare.com is Cloudflare DNS, which has its own tech; DNS alone doesn't mean the CDN proxies the site.

Vue.js._comment: data-v- / data-vue- attributes are also used by other libraries and analytics tags; replaced by the scoped-CSS hash form.

AngularJS._comment: Crossed path segments, so on angular.dev it matched the page's own scripts (https://angular.dev/chunk-x.js) and, as Angular and AngularJS exclude each other, hid Angular. Replaced in add with a form confined to the file name.

Snowplow Analytics._comment: Bare sp.js matched any script named like *sp.js (wsp.js, asp.js).

Next.js._comment: Next.js 16 builds with Turbopack by default, so Next.js doesn't mean Webpack. Webpack builds of Next.js are detected from their chunks (self.webpackChunk_N_E, see Webpack in add).

Remix._comment: Remix 3 isn't built on React. React and React Router are now detected from the globals of Remix 1-2 (see add).

Lightbox._comment: Was any script with 'lightbox' in its name (fancybox-lightbox, lightbox2 plugins of other libraries).

Element UI._comment: Anchor the class to a whole class name; el-button matched e.g. panel-button and model-select.

RxJS._comment: Was any rx*.js (e.g. prefix.js, apex.js via the optional parts).

RequireJS._comment: Was require.*\.js, which matched any script with 'require' anywhere before a .js.

Tiki Wiki CMS Groupware._comment: Was (?:/|_)tiki, which matched e.g. /tikitoki and _tiktok paths.

Bootstrap._comment: The version captures took any 7-40 hex characters, so cache-busting hashes became versions; keep numeric versions only.

Font Awesome._comment: The class check took any fa-* class (fa-ce, fa-de used by other icon sets); require Font Awesome's own style prefixes. The scriptSrc version capture took hex hashes.

PublishPress Blocks._comment: Fixed form of a source selector that doesn't parse.

Remix._comment: Remix 3 marks the head elements it manages.
Remix.description: Remix is a full-stack web framework. Remix 1 and 2 are built on React; Remix 3 is not.

React._comment: Remix 1-2 globals, which Remix no longer implies React from. In bundled JS: react-dom's devtools injection, which carries the version (injectIntoDevTools: bundleType, version, rendererPackageName), the fiber and props keys it sets on DOM nodes (internalInstanceKey, internalPropsKey; adjacent in ReactDOMComponentTree), and the error-decoder URL of React 16-18 production builds. Bare __reactFiber isn't used: session-replay and testing tools read it.

Vue.js._comment: In bundled JS: Vue 3's app.mount (rootContainer.__vue_app__ = app) and renderer setup (target.__VUE__ = true), and Vue 2's initMixin (vm._isVue = true). Reads of these (devtools, Alpine.js, other libraries checking for Vue objects) aren't assignments and don't match; __v_isRef and __isVue are used outside Vue.

Angular._comment: Server-rendered Angular: the styles it emits (<style ng-app-id>, emulated-encapsulation selectors) and its hydration markers.

Google Analytics._comment: Besides the gtag snippets: GA4 tag ids in JSON settings (Drupal's google_tag) and the US government's Digital Analytics Program loader, which runs GA4. scripts: live tags of a GTM container, for which gtm.go writes a 'gtm:tag __<template> id:<id> ' line each: a Google tag, GA4 config or GA4 event tag sending to a G- measurement id, or a Universal Analytics tag.

Hotjar._comment: scripts: a live Hotjar Tracking Code tag in a GTM container.

Google Ads Conversion Tracking._comment: GTM containers: a live Google Ads Conversion Tracking tag, or a Google tag for an AW- account; and gtag.js loaded for an AW- account.

Google Ads._comment: A live Google Ads Remarketing tag in a GTM container.

DoubleClick Floodlight._comment: A live Floodlight counter or sales tag, or a Google tag for a DC- account, in a GTM container.

Microsoft Advertising._comment: A live Microsoft Advertising UET tag in a GTM container (it also injects bat.bing.com/bat.js).

Linkedin Insight Tag._comment: A live LinkedIn Insight tag in a GTM container (it also injects insight.min.js).

Pinterest Conversion Tag._comment: A live Pinterest tag in a GTM container.

TikTok Pixel._comment: The pixel's loader host, as a script src or a GTM template's inject_script permission.

jQuery._comment: Unversioned jquery(.slim)(.min).js, as Drupal and WordPress serve it, which the remove of bare 'jquery' lost; the version from a ?v= or ?ver= query if there is one. Plugins (jquery.cookie.js, jquery-ui.js) don't match.

Lodash._comment: In bundled JS: lodash's HASH_UNDEFINED sentinel (Hash, SetCache; also in lodash-es and the per-method packages), and in the full build the VERSION, LARGE_ARRAY_SIZE and CORE_ERROR_TEXT constants, declared together at the top of lodash.js.

Moment.js._comment: In bundled JS: copyConfig (to._isAMomentObject = from._isAMomentObject; libraries that only test for moments read the flag), the deprecation message of the Date fallback in createFromInputFallback, and the version from moment.js's setup (hooks.version = '...'; setHookCallback(createLocal); hooks.fn = proto; hooks.min = min).
scripts: moment construction falls back to js Date\(\)

Axios._comment: In bundled JS: the isAxiosError flag axios sets on its errors (0.x enhanceError: error.isAxiosError = true; 1.x: defineProperty(AxiosError.prototype, 'isAxiosError', {value: true})) and 1.x's AxiosError name. Code that tests e.isAxiosError doesn't match. Versions: 1.x's env/data.js VERSION (const VERSION = "1.7.2"), which validator.js imports and bundlers place right before it (validators = {}; ['object', 'boolean', ...].forEach), and 0.x's bundled package.json.

Webpack._comment: In bundled JS: the chunk-loading global webpack 4 and 5 assign (self.webpackChunk<name> = self.webpackChunk<name> || [], window.webpackJsonp<name> = ...), the runtime's __webpack_require__ function and the properties it sets (__webpack_require__.d = ...), and the import of __webpack_require__ in ES-module output. The js keys only match the default global names. webpackChunkName (magic comments) has no assignment and doesn't match.

Redux._comment: In bundled JS: the type of the action createStore dispatches on creation (ActionTypes.INIT, '@@redux/INIT' + random).

Three.js._comment: In bundled JS: the warning Three.js gives when a page loads two copies, and the __THREE_DEVTOOLS__ events it dispatches (Object3D, WebGLRenderer).
scripts: Multiple instances of Three\.js being imported

core-js._comment: In bundled JS: the copyright core-js records in its shared store, with the version (store.versions.push({version, mode, copyright})). Lodash also reads __core-js_shared__, so that isn't used.

Sentry._comment: In bundled JS: the global carrier the Sentry SDK sets up (GLOBAL_OBJ.__SENTRY__ = GLOBAL_OBJ.__SENTRY__ || {}).

Akamai._comment: Akamai's request reference header and its Adaptive Acceleration cookie.
